title: AutoMorpheBuilder config.json
description: Structural schema for the build config consumed by morphe-build.yml and the Node.js helpers under .github/scripts/. Semantic checks (duplicate names, ABI enum drift, cross-key invariants) live in .github/scripts/validate-config.js and run on top of this schema in scripts/validate-config.js.

preferred_arch.description: Android ABI the downloader prefers when multiple APKs are available.

auto_update_urls.description: When true, pre_download_apks.sh writes resolved URLs back into download_urls.

honor_patch_opt_ins.description: When true, patches set true in patches.json are enabled even if off by default in structured patch lists.

repo.description: owner/repo slug for the morphe-desktop CLI repo on GitHub.

branch.description: morphe-desktop branch resolve-tag.sh will pin the CLI jar to.

download_urls.description: Cache of resolved APK download URLs, keyed by package id then version (or the literal 'latest_supported').

name.description: Release-name slug. Lowercase letters/digits/hyphens; used directly in GitHub release tags.

repo.description: Patch source. A bare owner/repo slug is a GitHub repository (unchanged default); a gitlab:owner/project prefix selects a top-level gitlab.com project, whose patches-*.mpp is resolved and SHA-256-verified through the generic package registry. Subgroup paths and self-hosted GitLab instances are rejected.

branch.description: Branch of the patch repo to fetch the patches-list.json + .mpp from.

apkmirror_path.description: APKMirror publisher/package slug (single slash, no whitespace).

pin_version.description: Optional. Numeric APK version pin that bypasses morphe-supported resolution.

extra_patches.description: Optional. Named patches from other GitHub patch sources, applied in addition to the app's own: { "owner/repo": ["Patch name", ...] }. Each source's latest release is used (one release per run, shared by all apps) and SHA-256-verified like other patches bundles. Changing this rebuilds only this app; a new release of an extra source alone does not. GitLab sources are not supported here.

display_name.description: Optional. Human-readable name used in README tables and the Obtainium deep-link. Falls back to a capitalised `name` when absent (so `nzb360` renders as `Nzb360` if no display_name is set). Set this when the slug alone doesn't spell the app name correctly (e.g. 'YouTube Music', 'NZB360', 'AIDA64').
